notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Humans and/or Wizards.
description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Auramancer to your hand.
Cast Auramancer by paying {3}.
Auramancer enters the battlefield, triggering Auramancer and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Auramancer trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {5}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
